==Description==
'''Headless''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 13 of the regular [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Pass|Null & Void Pass]] track. It was made by c4rpye. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it.

Upon use, it will grab out of its head to hold on the right arm.

It had a cost of {{GumDrops|285}} or {{Robux|38}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|1,790}} or {{Robux|587}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|48}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|742}}.
